name: theme-color
title: Theme Color
description: Resolves a theme CSS variable such as "--highlight" to an rgb() string that three.js and canvas code can parse, and re-reads it when the theme changes.

meta.when: Anything that cannot use a Tailwind class or `var()`: three.js materials, canvas drawing. In markup use the token classes (`bg-primary`, `fill-chart-1`) instead.
